all.release_notes: Polishes Quick Records icons so cattle, pigs and sheep match the sidebar, and aligns the Quick Records action icon with the rest of the app design.

windows.release_notes: Adds Quick Records, expanded livestock record types, adaptive setup fields, and matching livestock/sidebar icons.

android.release_notes: Fixes Android app identity so the APK updates the original Farming Ledger app icon instead of installing a second icon. Keeps Quick Records and on-device printed tag OCR.

ios.release_notes: Polishes Quick Records icons in the online app. iPhone and iPad users can use the live Farming Ledger web app and add it to the Home Screen.

chrome.release_notes: Polishes Quick Records icons so cattle, pigs and sheep match the sidebar.

web.release_notes: Polishes Quick Records icons so cattle, pigs and sheep match the sidebar.
